scaffold_contract.Bitset: opaque original pointer behind Len/Test/Words; New, Set, Complement, UnmarshalBinary and authored Assign callback wrappers. Original Set returns *BitSet; the binder discards that return explicitly. Assign copies the temporary owned bitset value after strict validation, without aliasing the rejected original receiver. Raw Words is borrowed; snapshots copy at most two uint64 words immediately into fixed arrays.
scaffold_contract.GJSON: Valid whole input then Parse root; exported Type/Raw/Num copied; opaque Result retained only for its exact Int method callback. No Get path or query string. Original Int has only int64 return, never an error channel.
scaffold_contract.ABI_direct_signatures_pending: Original wrappers and same-version source/module bindings must be supplied by Root in a later explicit native preparation.

availability.Complement: result pointer/state available if returned normally; no error return channel for any declared candidate signature; panic affects state knownness.
availability.JSON_original: int64 value available on normal return; error channel unavailable, including values 9007199254740993 and max-int64. No fabricated nil error. Missing requested error channel alone yields U.
availability.JSON_checked_or_discard: explicit returned error channel available. Nil/non-nil and own sentinel direct identity; no Error/String/Formatter calls. Failure value is not a required Want.
availability.Binary: error return channel available; source original errors remain their actual types/identities if available. Wants compare presence plus state, not invented original typed policy errors.
availability.panic: type/presence only; text unavailable unless a future bounded primitive-only policy is separately frozen. No Error/String/Formatter dispatch.

guards.huge_header_policy: Reject before original dispatch, preserving excluded-input status; not an observed baseline outcome.
guards.byte_order: Fresh worker, source default BigEndian; do not call mutable BigEndian/LittleEndian setters. Verify binding before any candidate dispatch.
guards.JSON: Complete JSON only, root Number, integer lexeme grammar minus? (0 or [1-9][0-9]*); no dot or exponent. No current exponent/invalid-JSON fixture: source-only policy, finite coverage explicitly limited.

call_count_status.direct_original_method_reservations: not frozen; New/Set/Len/Words/Test/Complement/Valid/Parse/Int/UnmarshalBinary and authored Assign must be included in a later scoped plan
call_count_status.checkpoint_durability: not implemented or attested by these inert candidates; before-method reservation and after-return snapshot ACK remain required before an actual run
